concept.hr: Fragmenti ili DF i ICMP „potrebna fragmentacija”, te crna rupa PMTUD-a
concept.en: Fragments vs DF and ICMP "fragmentation needed", and the PMTUD black hole

summary.hr: Mijenjaj veličinu paketa, MTU veze i tunel: usmjernik dijeli paket na fragmente ili ga uz DF odbacuje i javlja ICMP; blokiraj ICMP i dobij crnu rupu.
summary.en: Change packet size, link MTU and tunnel: the router splits the packet into fragments, or with DF drops it and reports ICMP; block ICMP and get a black hole.
